Idempotent replay receipt carries replay-attempt timestamp; non-blocking.
event_id is campaign-scoped; one-event-per-campaign model makes this safe; non-blocking.

checks.detail: All four terminal outcomes (SUCCEEDED/FAILED/TIMEOUT/CRASHED) append a terminal audit event and close the campaign via injectable backend.
require_campaign_open raises CampaignClosedError after closure; same-content retry idempotent; different content raises conflict.
TerminalAuditEvent and closure audit record contain only bounded hashes/refs/metrics; no raw labels, absolute paths or reconstructable holdout bytes; tests assert canary and raw path absence.
promotion_mode hard-locked to MANUAL_ONLY; no promote API.
All backends in-memory/fake; real holdout path never opened (positive sentinel test).
TaskSpec envelope verified (payload_sha256 9a664eb8a8c2e8837294470ad5350180f62235a9eeffc07cc6cbdf55c72c9510); scope/baseline/approval/T4 completion evidence refs hash-match.
